# `.editorconfig`

## Purpose

`.editorconfig` defines basic text-file conventions that compatible editors
apply automatically.

It helps contributors using different editors and operating systems produce
files with consistent indentation, encoding, line endings, and final-newline
behavior.

## Maintenance

Change `.editorconfig` when the project adopts different text conventions or
begins using file types that require different settings.

Most projects rarely need to modify it after the initial decisions have been
made.

## Canonical example

See the maintained annotated
[`.editorconfig`](../../canonical/.editorconfig).

::: {.callout-note title="Workshop companion"}
`.editorconfig` establishes consistent working conditions. It is the level
workbench that allows different people to bring different tools without
producing incompatible work.
:::
